name: permitproof
description: Source-linked Seattle pre-lease zoning and permit checklists for a narrow synthetic sample.

scripts.demo: npm run build && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/cli.js demo
scripts.validate:valid: npm run build && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/cli.js validate --input fixtures/applications/valid-documented-retail.json
scripts.validate:invalid: npm run build && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/cli.js validate --input fixtures/applications/invalid-malformed.json
